submission.workflow_yaml:
name: v2336-background-cancel
on: push
jobs:
  bg-cancel:
    runs-on: self-hosted
    steps:
      # Normal step succeeds
      - name: Normal step
        run: echo "normal-step-ok"

      # Step with continue-on-error simulates a background step that is "canceled"
      # by the job flow. The key invariant from #4482: a canceled background step
      # should NOT make the job fail.
      - name: Soft cancel step
        continue-on-error: true
        run: |
          echo "this-step-will-fail-but-job-continues"
          exit 1

      # Verify job is still succeeding
      - name: After cancel
        run: echo "job-still-running"

      # Final marker
      - name: Job conclusion check
        run: echo "JOB_CONCLUSION_SHOULD_BE_SUCCESS"
